events.summary: GitOps-owned policy ConfigMap and five schedule references, static regression and docs. Preserve includedResources, default fs-backup, annotations and RBAC. No cluster access, push or PR.

Lead measured on kakao-narwhal 2026-10-23 (read-only kubectl on podvolumebackups and pod specs): 107/115 PVBs were emptyDir (9,770 s); daily-full spent 4,373 s on 48 emptyDir PVBs versus 180 s on two PVC PVBs.

One storage ConfigMap with version v1 and only an emptyDir skip volumePolicy; all five schedules reference it. Unmatched PVCs use legacy selection, no includeExcludePolicy. Scratch is not restored; apisix-etcd starts empty as on any restart and re-syncs from CRDs (docs/common/apisix-etcd-recovery.md). Mirrored in the 08-4 install path. Documented failure modes: missing ConfigMap -> FailedValidation; with a policy present, Velero v1.18.1 looks up every PVC's PV, so a PVC without an available PV errors (all PVCs Bound on 2026-10-23); no Velero failure alert yet (#456).
